publishers.name: AWS Student Builder Group UP Mindanao / AWS SBG Apex Ateneo de Davao
publishers.suggested_adapter: html_homepage with explicit include_self and full page CTF identity detection
publishers.qualification: The annual conference publisher root has no edition in its URL, includes a prior-year gallery, and currently advertises a Capture The Flag track before November 28, 2026. A historical organizer teaser and organizer-authored recap establish that its prior CTF was an actual competition. This monitors an identified recurring publisher; it does not discover an unknown organizer.

advance_evidence.summary: Current conference page lists a distinct Capture The Flag schedule track and conference ticket CTA. The page is read before its stated November 28, 2026 conference date.

Prior 2025 teaser describes the AWS CTF booth and asks readers to follow for registration opening; another organizer post describes CTF competitions. No exact post publication timestamp independently established.
Recap identifies the prior event's cloud CTF as a competitive track operated by the club Security Department.

publishers.limitations: The ticket form is for the conference, not confirmed separate CTF registration. Conference eligibility must not automatically become CTF eligibility. Search index retained an older schedule mentioning CTF Tournament Awarding; current backend page has Capture The Flag track. Prefer live page facts and retain ambiguity.

publishers.name: FEU Educational Innovation and Technology Hub — Eventually
publishers.suggested_adapter: html_index reading relevant event bodies even when titles omit CTF

advance_evidence.summary: Invitation-style school event listing explicitly describes competitions including Capture the Flag. It identifies the AITS club as organizer, FEU Tech-only and student-only restrictions. Publication timestamp is not established.
A differently dated rendition explicitly says Event Cancelled. Must preserve cancellation and avoid treating the program's overall date range as a precise CTF interval.

publishers.limitations: The /discover/status/published and AITS organizer URLs returned JavaScript shells without event links despite richer search-index text. Current /discover page works but only exposes its recent cards. First h1 is the website title Eventually, so prefer og:title. Whole main includes recommended unrelated events; use #event-info for identity. The rendition ending 1760705638 is explicitly a draft and should not be published.
